entities.summary: Sara Pennypacker is an American author of children's books. Her books, some of which have featured on the New York Times bestselling list, include The Lions' Run, Leeva At Last, Pax, Summer of the Gypsy Moths, the Clementine series, the Waylon series, and the Stuart books.
